name: 元の発言を添えるスレッド返信通知
prompt:
Create a faithful static, standalone Slack thread-reply notification card in Japanese. Target the native preview’s 390×196 frame and use the exact source crop for its order and spacing. The source screenshot is dimmed because an unrelated schedule sheet is open over it; render this notification cleanly on its white standalone surface, as shown by the native preview.

At top left place the simple pale mint circular placeholder avatar with 「山」. To its right, show bold sender 「山田 はるか」 and the small gray time 「11:17」 aligned at the top right. Below, show the gray context label 「スレッドに返信しました」.

Next show the excerpt title 「次の相談に向けて準備したい内容」 in clear blue (#1478E8). This title is a link in the source. Below it, show the two-line reply body exactly:
「前に共有した内容を確認してください。」
「よろしくお願いします。」
Use dark near-black text.

At the bottom, show 「新しい返信を見る」 in the same clear blue (#1478E8), because it corresponds to the source’s blue “View newer replies” link. Only these two link labels are blue. Keep sender name, timestamp, context label, and reply body dark or gray.

Use compact, readable system typography and the native preview’s clean white surface. No thread/channel header, phone chrome, status bar, footer, schedule modal, dim overlay, extra icons, or additional copy.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against original crop and Japanese native preview. The two link labels are blue per user direction; all other text is dark/gray. Exact Japanese copy and 390x196 layout match.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
